During Level 2 cleaning, when both Molding areas are processing caramel products, we need to remove the trays and cylinders for cleaning. Currently, the limited number of transport carts forces us to wait for a cart to be washed and emptied before it can be used again.


For this reason, we request that you consider adding two additional transport carts, such as those shown in the image. This will help streamline cleaning, reduce wait times, and most importantly prevent staff from having to rust the process, thereby lowering the risk of accidents
